'''Star Tours Flight 514''' was the designation of a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency flight to [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] just before a [[Raid at Spaceport THX1138|raid]] at the Star Tours space station. It was on time and stationed at Gate 1A, and its estimated time of departure was 0815 hours.

At another time, a flight with the same details was set to depart from Gate 2C.
